_about: Canonical legal footer for BOTH sites. arborhillsmonitor.org pages are checked by tests/test_site_footer.py; policy.arborhillsmonitor.org (repo tkunst/better-arbor-hills) vendors a copy of this file and its footer-drift workflow fails if the copy and this file differ.
